info.name: HRMS API
info.description:
Complete HRMS backend API collection (/api/v1).

Setup:
1. Set `baseUrl` (default http://localhost:5000/api/v1)
2. Run Auth → Login and copy accessToken into collection variable
3. Fill resource IDs from list responses as needed

Auth: Bearer {{accessToken}} on all routes except login/refresh/health/holidays(public).

request.description: Sends a 6-digit OTP to the email via Brevo SMTP (from developer@fiberisefit.com).
Manager default: team leaves (managerId filter). Use scope=self for own.
Auto-approved on raise — no manager approve step
Public with optional auth. Without token pass companyId or companyCode.
